title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: Every Kotlin modifier is a soft keyword, so `value` and `data` name variables every day. Matching them bare made a cut stop one line short and leave code that does not compile.

highlights.title: Cuts that stopped one line short
highlights.description: A continuation line starting with `value`, `data` or `open` read as a new declaration, so the line above was judged finished and cut alone. A modifier counts now when a hard keyword follows it, or, in Java, a type and a name.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: A cut could stop one line short and leave code behind that does not compile. `open` was already matched bare; 1.42.233 added eleven more words and widened the hole.
The expression walk stops on a semicolon at bracket depth zero, so it can no longer read on into the Java method below.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: Not reachable on the 6329 source project this is measured against: the same 418 findings keep the same 418 cuts, byte for byte. The shape is ordinary Kotlin all the same.
